modules.module_title: Life Sciences industry and Quality assurance

pcs.pc_description: discuss the insight of the major segments within the life sciences industry (pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, etc.).
explain the importance of current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), ICH, ISO9001, ISO 13485, IEC-60601-2, ISO/IEC 27001, Global MDR and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) in quality assurance.
Describe the core skills required for a Quality Assurance, such as knowledge of QA processes, analytical techniques, documentation, and problem-solving.
use QA terminologies accurately in discussions about QA procedures and processes.
analyze how non-compliance can lead to product recalls, safety issues, regulatory action, and harm to the environment.
explain the significance of scheduled inspections and audits to maintain product quality.
identify typical QA procedures (e.g., sampling, in-process checks, final product inspections) and the frequency of these checks.
prepare a Master Validation Plan (MVP) for ensuring that manufacturing processes consistently produce high-quality products.
proper collection and storage of stability and control samples during packaging processes.

modules.module_title: Adhere to health and hygiene protocols

pcs.pc_description: comply with health and personal hygiene- related protocols as per WHO standards and ICH GMP guidelines
sanitize your hands before entering in laboratory and production area and ensure the adherence of same by subordinates as per SOP
report any allergy, sickness or any other environment-related breach before or after entering the work premises to the designated person
take preventive actions on the report of any allergy, sickness or any other environment-related breach by subordinates
wear lab coat all the time while working in a laboratory and ensure adherence of the same by every person visiting/ working in the lab area
follow gowning procedures while entering an environment controlled work area and ensure the adherence of the same by subordinates

modules.module_title: Adhere to safety and security procedures

pcs.pc_description: observe compliance by self and subordinates with safety and security policies and procedures
ensure the use of appropriate safety gears like headgear, masks, gloves and other accessories as mentioned in the guidelines, by self and subordinates while carrying out work
use helmets, ropes, harness, and ladders while working at heights
use pulleys/ forklift (if available) to transport the material/ spares/ heavy assembly and tools
take preventive and corrective actions on the report of any identified breaches in safety and security policies and procedures by subordinates
segregate material and follow the 5S system at the storage area as per cGMP
adhere to storage and handling guidelines for hazardous material
supervise the disposal of waste/unused and expired reagents/ chemicals / biological waste using environmentally sustainable methods in the presence of EHS personnel
identify and correct any hazards that one can deal with safely, competently and within the limits of authority in consultation with EHS personnel
complete record the details of completed safety drills and training undertaken by self and subordinates
raise the alarm and report any hazards that one is not competent to deal with, to the relevant person in line with organizational procedures and warn other people who may be affected
follow emergency protocol for any alarms and ensure the safety of subordinates in the area under supervision
follow emergency procedures efficiently
ensure injured employees are provided appropriate first aid and medical aid
